name: MINER
full_name: Mitchell Institute Neutrino Experiment at Reactor
summary: A low-threshold cryogenic experiment near a reactor that has published measured searches for reactor-produced ALPs in addition to neutrino measurements.
detection_principle: Reactor photon processes can produce ALPs, which scatter or decay in sapphire crystals and deposit energy; TES sensors read out athermal phonons.

phases.name: HFIR relocation
phases.description: The 2025 literature proposes relocation to ORNL HFIR. This is a subsequent neutrino plan and does not establish new ALP data.

results.summary: The first 2025 ALP search constrains photon and electron couplings. The region below 3 keV is reserved for a separate CEνNS analysis; the hardware threshold is not this ALP analysis threshold.

science_scope: Produces and detects axions or dark-sector particles in the laboratory, rather than directly measuring Galactic-halo dark-matter flux. It tests interactions of dark-matter candidates; identifying a discovered particle as dark matter would also require establishing its cosmic abundance.
